title: golden family scoring
description: How findings match a golden family, what each severity costs in minutes, and the verdict bounds — one file beside the goldens, shared by every definition scored against them.

minutes.description: fix minutes per severity — the unavoidable work a correctly found and classified finding costs

escapeMultiplier.description: factor on a severity's minutes when its defect is missed and merged

triageLine.description: lowest severity a human handles; a finding truly at or above it but reported below it is never looked at and counts as escaped

fixFactor.description: per severity, the share of its minutes that reviewing a machine fix costs; a fix the fix check did not confirm costs that review plus the full minutes; an open finding costs full minutes
